connector.name: A2CR
connector.registryDescription: Save AI-agent handoff checkpoints, WorkStash notes, and WorkThreads in a local A2CR workspace.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package a2cr-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the a2cr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: A2CR_LOCAL_DB
env.description: Optional path for the local A2CR SQLite database. Leave unset to use the OS default app-data location.
